title: Enhanced photocatalytic H2 evolution and H2O2 generation via ZnIn2S4/g-C3N4 heterojunction
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2018, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00150E, Paper
Li Zhou, Yanming Zhou, Yujie Jia, Qiqi Gu, Qiaoyi Xiao, Xiao Wang, Suping Zhang, Hongmei Wang
In this study, ZnIn2S4/g-C3N4 heterojunctions were synthesized via an ultrasonic-assisted solventevaporation strategy. The structure, morphology, surface chemistry, optical response, and photoelectrochemical behavior were systematically characterized by XRD, TEM, XPS, UV-Vis...
